mapper.select: SELECT subject FROM organization_person WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND active=TRUE AND approval_eligible=TRUE ORDER BY subject
SELECT id,display_name FROM organization_person WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND active=TRUE AND approval_eligible=TRUE ORDER BY display_name,id

SELECT u.id,u.name,u.kind, CASE WHEN a.active=TRUE AND a.department_id=u.id AND p.active=TRUE AND p.approval_eligible=TRUE AND j.active=TRUE THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS head_available FROM organization_unit u JOIN organization_unit l ON l.tenant_id=u.tenant_id AND l.id=u.legal_entity_id AND l.active=TRUE LEFT JOIN organization_appointment a ON a.tenant_id=u.tenant_id AND a.id=u.head_appointment_id LEFT JOIN organization_person p ON p.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND p.id=a.person_id LEFT JOIN organization_unit j ON j.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND j.id=a.position_id WHERE u.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND u.active=TRUE AND u.kind IN ('DEPARTMENT','POSITION') ORDER BY u.kind,u.name,u.id
SELECT id,name,kind FROM organization_unit WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND kind IN ('DEPARTMENT','POSITION') AND active=TRUE ORDER BY kind,name,id
SELECT id,display_name FROM organization_person WHERE tenant_id=#{argument1} AND active=TRUE AND approval_eligible=TRUE ORDER BY display_name,id

SELECT DISTINCT p.subject FROM organization_appointment a JOIN organization_person p ON p.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND p.id=a.person_id AND p.active=TRUE JOIN organization_unit d ON d.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND d.id=a.department_id AND d.active=TRUE JOIN organization_unit j ON j.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND j.id=a.position_id AND j.active=TRUE JOIN organization_unit l ON l.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND l.id=d.legal_entity_id AND l.active=TRUE WHERE a.tenant_id=#{argument1} AND a.active=TRUE AND p.approval_eligible=TRUE AND (a.department_id=#{argument2} OR a.position_id=#{argument3}) ORDER BY p.subject

SELECT a.department_idposition_id AS id,COUNT(DISTINCT p.subject) AS members FROM organization_appointment a JOIN organization_person p ON p.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND p.id=a.person_id AND p.active=TRUE JOIN organization_unit d ON d.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND d.id=a.department_id AND d.active=TRUE JOIN organization_unit j ON j.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND j.id=a.position_id AND j.active=TRUE JOIN organization_unit l ON l.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND l.id=d.legal_entity_id AND l.active=TRUE WHERE a.tenant_id=#{argument1} AND a.active=TRUE AND p.approval_eligible=TRUE GROUP BY a.department_idposition_id
